stem: What happens next in this passage after “Airport workers explained that speed and security both mattered.”?
options: Many people can see copies, but ownership and originality still matter in different ways.
A student working part-time there said the hardest part was not the technology.
A student watching the process noticed that technology sorted people into different experiences.
A student riding in the silent car noticed how different the journey felt.
